mistakes.text: She said that she wants one exactly like it.
mistakes.normalized: she said that she wants one exactly like it
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „said“ sa v Reported speech Present Simple zvyčajne mení na Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „said“ se v Reported speech Present Simple obvykle mění na Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “said”, Reported speech usually moves the Present Simple back to the Past Simple.

mistakes.text: She said that she wanted exactly such one.
mistakes.normalized: she said that she wanted exactly such one
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Taký“ sa tu neprekladá ako „such one“; povedz „one exactly like it“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Takový“ se tu nepřekládá jako „such one“; řekni „one exactly like it“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Such one” isn't correct English; say “one exactly like it”.
